'''Vosh''' was a potent, two-hundred proof [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage. Vosh possessed a distinct sky-blue [[Color/Legends|coloration]], and could be paired with small lumps of [[geref]] that would bob and float in the alcohol once added, only to slowly sublime into vapor over [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="APM" />

[[Bar Jaraniz]], an unsavory [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcaf]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], possessed at least one spiral bottle of vosh with added geref. The tapcaf served [[Glass/Legends|glasses]] of vosh to patrons, along with [[Water/Legends|water]] or [[Ale/Legends|ale]]. One of the [[Unidentified Bar Jaraniz bartender|bartenders]] that worked at the establishment was known to use vosh in the construction of an [[Jaraniz cocktail|elaborate cocktail]], alongside a number of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] segments and skewers.<ref name="APM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vosh was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[New Jedi Order era]] [[EBook|e-novella]] entitled ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'', written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[August]], [[2006]].<ref name="APM" />

Described in the novella as two-hundred-proof alcohol, this suggests that vosh is meant to be understood as an example of pure alcohol. In reality, pure alcohol rarely exists outside of a laboratory. Once the alcohol is opened to the air, it begins to absorb moisture from the surrounding atmosphere, and will thus self-dilute down to approximately 194 proof.<ref name="Proof">{{WebCite|url=https://www.alcoholproblemsandsolutions.org/alcohol-proof-and-alcohol-by-volume-definitions-and-explanations|text=Alcohol Problems and Solutions|archivedate=20170804151907}}</ref>
